release_notes: Build 94 makes Archive completed C self-reconcile previously archived Quiz History rows that have fallen back to their old C: path, using the independent archive journal as exact proof of History ID, previous C: path, Z: destination, and database path.
Journal reconciliation changes only the Quiz History database link and never deletes or moves files; rows without exact journal proof remain safety-skipped.
Duplicate C: safety messages now show the exact Quiz History IDs that reference the same folder instead of a generic duplicate warning.

The archive preview is faster because Factburst no longer recursively fingerprints every Z: quiz folder; it indexes Z: folder names first and reads only the exact-name Z: candidates needed for a C: project.
Pressing Yes no longer reruns the entire expensive preview. The confirmed preview is used and every item is individually rechecked immediately before its action.

A live progress window now shows x of y, the current History ID and quiz, the current archive stage, the C: source path, and the Z: destination while projects are being copied, verified, linked, or removed.
Quiz History Z: paths are read back and confirmed before C: deletion, followed by a post-run journal reconciliation and another reconciliation after the Quiz History UI refresh.
Existing Z: folders remain protected: they are never overwritten or deleted, and new-copy collisions continue to use archived-copy NNN destinations.
